name: confluence
description: Search and read Confluence pages across one or two instances, with macro content (task reports, page properties, panels, inline tasks) included; edit the tables on a page in place (even inside table filter or column macros), and create, update and append to pages, and upload attachments (replacing an image on a page); download page attachments into the folder the matching plugin reads; save a page to the knowledge base when you ask - writing only when switched on.
